verdict.rationale: The evidence documents versioning mechanics: a plugin.json version field, marketplace version tracking and automatic updates, and a Skill Versions API. Nothing shows releases shipping with release notes or a changelog that describes what changed in the skills. Version numbers and update tracking are an adjacent feature and do not let a developer see the changes before updating.

support.subject: As a developer, releases ship with notes or a changelog so I can see what changed in the skills before I take an update
